versions.subject: Big Update
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\node.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -e '
        - ' --eval '
# Add more pattern of abuse as actions
action_reverse_shell:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '.exec('
        - 'net.socket'
        - '.connect'
        - 'child_process'
condition: selection and 1 of action_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\node.exe" CommandLine IN ("* -e *", "* --eval *") CommandLine="*.exec(*" CommandLine="*net.socket*" CommandLine="*.connect*" CommandLine="*child_process*"
